note: 20-60 live overlays at any time. An EMPTY register is valid and means the matrix runs unadjusted. A LAPSED overlay is not valid and stops the cycle (s4.1, s10.6). This is the artefact the project 09 control report reads monthly, and the failure it exists to prevent is a 70% dial applied during one bad quarter, never reviewed, still quietly suppressing every increase in the book three years later with nobody able to say who set it or why.
